en: Every agent session starts its own proxy.
And every proxy starts its own copy of each MCP server.
Ten sessions and five servers make fifty server processes, and nothing shows them together.
LeanProxy can now run as one shared gateway.
One command installs it as a background service, started at login.
Each client connects by URL: Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor or OpenCode.
All sessions share one set of servers, and each keeps its own exposure mode.
The admin dashboard lists every server, with a one line diagnosis.
Here, a token expired: authentication refused.
You can restart, disable or remove a server from the page.
It also shows the connected clients and the latest tool calls: who called what, and how long it took.
Arguments and results are never recorded.
Add a server from the page or from the command line.
The gateway picks it up within seconds, with no restart.
One process, one set of servers, one place to look.
